note: The values skills and combat decide by (docs/52-skills.md). Ranges are game units; times are milliseconds unless a key says seconds. Read once when the world starts: restart the world after changing it.

spell_range.doc: How far a targeted spell, signet or skill reaches: the client's cast range.

touch_range.doc: How far a touch skill reaches (Vampiric Touch).

adjacent_range.doc: The radius 'adjacent' means: Cyclone Axe, Imagined Burden's spread, Shatter Delusions' blast.

melee_range.doc: How far a melee attack or attack skill reaches. The owner's report on 2026-11-14: a hammer at 144 reached too far, and melee should be quite close; 50 is the interaction distance this machine already chose for walking to an NPC (config/Server/movement.json, interact_range), not the touch spell's 144. The client's own click range may still be wider; the server walks the character in and only accepts the hit here.

bow_range.doc: How far a bow attack skill reaches.

projectile_speed.doc: How fast a ranged weapon's shot flies, in map units per second. The flight is the distance from the shooter to the aim point over this, so a shot at 100 units arrives in 0.06 s and one at 1,000 in 0.63 s. GWW's bow table puts the shortbow at 0.59 s for its 1004 range; the live corpus's weapon speeds are round classes (1200, 1600, 2800) and 1600 is the bow/spear class (Rurik content/world.toml weapon_type.bow).

dodge_tolerance.doc: How far a projectile's target may stand from the aim, measured ACROSS the line of fire from the shooter to the aim, and still be hit. The measured live rule: a shot connects inside 54 u across and 114 u along; outside it the client draws a dodge. The mechanism is a reconstruction fitted inside retail's zero-violation bands [51.0, 57.5] across and [101, 128] along (Rurik toolkit/authsrv/authsrv.py:17340-17375).

dodge_along.doc: How far short of, or past, the aim a projectile's target may stand ALONG the line of fire and still be hit; see dodge_tolerance. A target that runs straight away or straight in stays inside this; one that steps sideways leaves it.

range_tolerance.doc: How far past a skill's reach the server still accepts a target, as a multiple of the reach: the client's reported position lags its walk.

health_base.doc: A player's health before levels: maximum health is health_base + health_per_level * level.

energy_max.doc: A player's maximum energy. 25 is what this world already sent every player (asura-protocol PLAYER_ENERGY_MAX).

energy_regen_pips.doc: A player's energy regeneration, in pips. One pip is a third of an energy per second.

health_pip_per_second.doc: Health one regeneration pip restores (or one degeneration pip removes) per second.

energy_pip_per_second.doc: Energy one pip restores per second.

regen_pip_cap.doc: The most pips health regeneration or degeneration can sum to, either way.

spell_strike_per_level.doc: A spell's strike level is this times the caster's level; damage is base * 2^((strike - armor) / 40).

weapon_strike_per_rank.doc: A weapon attack's strike level is this times the caster's rank in the weapon's attribute.

armor_divisor.doc: The divisor in the damage formula's exponent.

player_armor_default.doc: A player's armor rating when its equipped pieces carry no armor word: the rating the damage tables are normalised to.

adrenaline_per_hit.doc: Adrenaline units every adrenal skill on the bar gains when an attack hits. 25 units are one strike.

divine_favor_attribute.doc: The attribute index of Divine Favor.

divine_favor_heal_per_rank.doc: Extra healing a primary Monk's healing spell gives an ally per rank of Divine Favor.

monk_profession.doc: The profession id of the Monk.

condition_skills.doc: The client's skill id for each condition: the id an effect add for a condition carries.

condition_degeneration.doc: Health degeneration pips a condition adds while it lasts.

weapons.doc: The weapons an attack skill can be used with, by the item's type code: the attribute its strike level reads, the swing time, its damage type and whether it shoots. The damage range is the item's own 584 modifier.

weapon_requirements.doc: A skill's `weapon` key, as the item type code it requires.

armor_slots.doc: Each body-armor item type and its share of the armor rating: chest, legs, head, hands, feet.

knockdown_ms.doc: How long a knockdown lasts when a skill names none.
